question.text: A portfolio's TOTAL risk can be decomposed into:

explanation.text: The Logic: Total investment risk = Systematic (market) risk + Unsystematic (specific/idiosyncratic) risk. Diversification reduces the unsystematic component. The Trap: Alpha-Beta describes return attribution, not risk decomposition. Cross-Exam Context: XV, X-A, XXI-A all test this; XXI-B treats it as foundation for Risk topic. Manager's Pro-Tip: Beyond 30-35 well-diversified stocks, additional diversification offers minimal unsystematic-risk reduction — plan portfolio size accordingly.
